Current source/task/valueset-task-code.xml is version 6.0.0 and includes CodeSystem/task-code without a version child; source/task/codesystem-task-code.xml is also version 6.0.0. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant contrary evidence.
reconciliation: No source changes were made. The stale include version reported by the issue is absent from current authoritative source, and reintroducing an include-level version would be unnecessary.
